title: "LIQPLAT recruitment"
date: 2026-08-20

  html:
    toc: true

  message: false
---

Recruitment is summarized from the pseudonymized event interface. The source
screening and random-selection dates are used only to build aggregate counts;
individual dates and identifiers are never printed.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "population_recruitment"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "01-population"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
recruitment_path <- file.path(result_dir, "recruitment-summary.parquet")
figure_path <- file.path(result_dir, "recruitment-cumulative.svg")
input_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                        "analysis-cohort.parquet")
recruitment_input_path <- file.path(
  module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
  "analysis-recruitment.parquet"
)
if (!file.exists(input_path) || !file.exists(recruitment_input_path)) {
  stop("Recruitment requires the built analysis cohort and recruitment Parquet.")
}
input_paths <- c(input_path, recruitment_input_path)
output_paths <- c(recruitment_path, figure_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "01-population", "01-recruitment.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  recruitment_summary <- read_result_table(recruitment_path)
} else {
  recruitment <- read_result_table(recruitment_input_path)
  require_public_columns(recruitment, c("id", "screened_date", "eligible"),
                         "recruitment accounting")
  recruitment$screened_date <- parse_analysis_date(recruitment$screened_date,
                                                   "screened_date", allow_missing = FALSE)
  recruitment$eligible <- validate_binary(recruitment$eligible, "eligible",
                                          allow_missing = FALSE)
  if ("randomization_date" %in% names(recruitment)) {
    recruitment$randomization_date <- parse_analysis_date(recruitment$randomization_date,
                                                           "randomization_date")
  }
  if ("enrolled_date" %in% names(recruitment)) {
    recruitment$enrolled_date <- parse_analysis_date(recruitment$enrolled_date,
                                                     "enrolled_date")
  }
  if ("tx" %in% names(recruitment)) recruitment$tx <- validate_binary(recruitment$tx, "tx")
  if (anyDuplicated(recruitment$id)) {
    id_groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(recruitment)), as.character(recruitment$id), drop = TRUE)
    recruitment_rows <- lapply(id_groups, function(index) {
      part <- recruitment[index, , drop = FALSE]
      result <- data.frame(
        id = as.character(part$id[[1L]]),
        screened_date = min(part$screened_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        eligible = as.integer(max(part$eligible, na.rm = TRUE)),
        recruitment_records = nrow(part),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      if ("randomization_date" %in% names(part)) {
        values <- part$randomization_date[!is.na(part$randomization_date)]
        result$randomization_date <- if (length(values) == 0L) as.Date(NA) else min(values)
      }
      if ("enrolled_date" %in% names(part)) {
        values <- part$enrolled_date[!is.na(part$enrolled_date)]
        result$enrolled_date <- if (length(values) == 0L) as.Date(NA) else min(values)
      }
      if ("tx" %in% names(part)) {
        values <- unique(part$tx[!is.na(part$tx)])
        if (length(values) > 1L) stop("Conflicting recruitment assignment for patient.")
        result$tx <- if (length(values) == 0L) NA_integer_ else as.integer(values[[1L]])
      }
      result
    })
    recruitment <- do.call(rbind, recruitment_rows)
    rownames(recruitment) <- NULL
  }
  recruitment_summary <- data.frame(
    step = c("screened", "eligible", "selected_for_invitation", "not_selected"),
    n = c(
      nrow(recruitment),
      sum(recruitment$eligible == 1),
      if ("tx" %in% names(recruitment)) sum(recruitment$eligible == 1 & recruitment$tx == 1,
                                             na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_,
      if ("tx" %in% names(recruitment)) sum(recruitment$eligible == 1 & recruitment$tx == 0,
                                             na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if ("enrolled_date" %in% names(recruitment)) {
    recruitment_summary <- rbind(
      recruitment_summary,
      data.frame(step = "enrolled", n = sum(!is.na(recruitment$enrolled_date)),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    )
  }
  write_module_table(recruitment_summary, recruitment_path)

  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required for the recruitment figure.")
  }
  selected <- recruitment[!is.na(recruitment$randomization_date), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(selected) > 0L) {
    selected <- selected[order(selected$randomization_date), , drop = FALSE]
    selected$cumulative_n <- seq_len(nrow(selected))
    plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(selected, ggplot2::aes(randomization_date, cumulative_n)) +
      ggplot2::geom_step() +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "Calendar month", y = "Cumulative selected patients") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  } else {
    plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "Calendar month", y = "Cumulative selected patients",
                    subtitle = "No random-selection dates available at the data lock.") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  }
  assert_artifact_path(figure_path)
  ggplot2::ggsave(figure_path, plot = plot, width = 8, height = 4, units = "in")
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "built"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "01-population", "01-recruitment.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: recruitment-table
#| tbl-cap: "Aggregate recruitment accounting"

recruitment_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
